title: Shin et al. 2017 (Experiment B) — Open Access Dataset for EEG+NIRS Single-Trial Classification
description: This dataset contains EEG recordings (30 channels, with EOG) from 29 healthy participants performing a mental arithmetic task (serial subtraction) versus a resting baseline. It is Experiment B of an open-access hybrid brain-computer interface resource that also includes simultaneous NIRS recordings. Data were collected over multiple sessions, preprocessed, and converted to BIDS using MOABB, to support single-trial classification and hybrid BCI research.
methods_description: EEG was recorded with BrainAmp amplifiers and active electrodes in a 10-5 montage (30 channels plus EOG), initially at 1000 Hz and downsampled to 200 Hz. Each session included a 1-min pre-rest, 20 trials (2 s visual instruction, 10 s task, 15-17 s rest), and a 1-min post-rest. Preprocessing comprised common average reference, 0.5-50 Hz Chebyshev type II bandpass filtering, and ICA-based EOG rejection. Classification used CSP log-variance features with shrinkage LDA and 10x5-fold cross-validation.
